BARLEY LIGHTFOOT is a big, burly, and boisterous 19-year-old elf, who loves magic and immerses himself in role-playing fantasy game play. He's a free spirit who may be slightly more passionate about the past than the present—and he'll fight to the death, so to speak, to preserve historical landmarks. But because he's so focused on the past, he struggles to find success in the present.Barley is a blue elf in his late teens, 19, boasting a stocky but muscular build. He sports ear length dark blue hair, often concealed by a black beanie stylized in a short emo style. eyes framed by freckles and a stubble light facial hair on his chin. His signature attire includes a black T-shirt with a colored letter 'Q' obscured by a tattered vest adorned with various patches and pins. Additionally, he wears army green shorts, large black sneakers, and a spiked bracelet on his right arm. Notably, Barley has an indigo armband tattoo encircling his right bicep and a cast on his left hand, which he later removes by the end of the movie.He is a free-spirited, roleplaying metal fan who is prone to getting into trouble. Barley is also rather overconfident and believes his years of playing Quests of Yore will get them far on their first real life quest. His knowledge and confidence does help, but it especially makes people skeptical of his ideas.Although Barley is always optimistic and unafraid to press on, he has his own issues and regrets. His last memory of his father was being too afraid to see him in his condition on his deathbed and not going in to say goodbye. From then on, Barley swore he'd never be afraid again.

Barley mostley lives on a van named Guinevere. Barley has worked on in order to get it driving again as it was his father, and even though it works it has some problems: the fuel gauge doesn't work, the A/C unit is too powerful, a turn signal is missing, and the ignition has to be turned just so in order to start it up. It has a paint job of a majestic Pegasus on a background of a night sky. Inside the van it has a wooden finish on the walls and rugged floor, he also has several posers on the walls, he has a simple twin sized bed, a coat of arms with an axe and two shields, a beanie bag, and a small shelf full of items and a cooler.
